I answered Pree in a thread under her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it to support on #8841.

He called it "Tobias's dealer account", though, and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I'm assuming that's the same account because the January handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks was changing hands. I told her that and suggested she check with Tobias before the call.

I also warned her about similar-looking ticket numbers in the history: #88412 is the old Tansleigh Packaging scanner ticket, and #4409 and #4412 are older Salina North tickets.

I only used #central-random, #central-team and public files, all of which she can see herself.
